verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v1: hali d-dahru ʾin ṭāra l-ghurābu yaṭību wajāʾa rasūlu l-mawti baʿdu yanūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v2: ʾarāka nasīta l-mawta wal-mawtu mawridu fal-kulli min baḥri l-mamāti naṣību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v3: ʾalā kullu mawlūdi falā shakka ʾannahu yusallimuhu yā dhā l-ḥabību shaʿūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v4: ʾalā kullu mawlūdi waʾin ṭāla ʿumruhu sayadʿūhu dāʿī hulkahi wayujību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v5: waʾiyyāka tadbīrā famā huwa nāfiʿu wasallim ʾilā llāhi l-ʾumūra tatūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v6: wakhayyir walā takhtar fakayfa khtiyārunā waʾinna maghabbāti l-ʾumūri taghību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v7: ʾalā fārḍa mā yaqḍī l-ʾilahu bimulkihi fafīhi riḍā man bil-muṭīʿi yuthību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v8: wamā yafʿalu l-hādī l-jalīlu bimulkihi fadhāka jamīlu yartaḍīhi munību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v9: ʾalā dāru dunyā dāru nawkā wajīfatu yujādhibuhā fāḥdhar bitilka kalību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v10: ʾalā ʾinnahā dāru l-ghurūri faman ṣafā lahu l-ʿayshu minhā fal-kudūru ʿaqību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v11: ʾalā ʾinnamā d-dunyā sarābu biqīʿati fayaḥsabuhā ẓ-ẓāmī sh-sharāba yajūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v12: ʾilayhi masāfāti wa ʾiyyāhu lam yajid bishayʾi waʾinna l-ḥayna minhu muṣību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v13: laʾasḥaru min hārūta mārūta qāla dhā shafīʿu likulli l-mudhnibīna ḥabību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v14: ʾalā ḥubbuhā raʾasu l-khaṭāyā jamīʿihā wayulqī d-dunā ẓahra l-warāʾi labību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v15: ʿajūzu farūku fī thiyābi ʿarūbati ghurūru d-dunā l-māḍīna qablu ʿajību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v16: waʾin ʾaḍḥakat yawmā satubkī bisurʿahi walā khayra fī lladhdhāti baʿdu lahību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v17: ʾalā mithlu dūdi l-qazzi man yajmaʿu d-dunā wad-dūdu fī mansūjihā latabūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v18: walā tak mimman ghurra min baʿdi ghaflahi wayawmu zdiḥāmi l-ʿālamīna ʿaṣību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v19: qabāʾiḥahā tukhfī watubdī maḥāsinā nazūʿu limā tuʿṭī l-ḥabība salūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v20: walā tansa ṭūla d-dahri lā tansa laylata ṣabīḥatuhā fīhā tuʿʿadu ʿuyūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v21: ʾalā ʾākhira l-ʾanfāsi dāwim bifikrihi dhakiyyū l-ḥijā yawma l-firāqi yahību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v22: fayā ʾayyuhā l-bānī maḥalla ḍiyāfati ʾalam taʿlaman ʾanna l-jalāʾa qarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v23: satukhbiruka l-ʾayyāmu ʾannaka lāʿibu kaʾannaka yā hadhā l-ghabiyyū salību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v24: laʿamruka mā yughnī l-maghānī ʿani l-fatā ʾidhā ḍamma ʾawṣāla l-murabbi tarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v25: fayā wayḥa fāni kāna yashtaddu fāniyā tamassak bibāqi laysa ʿanka yaghību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v26: waʿudda mina l-ʾamwāti nafsaka nābidhā warāʾaka dunyā lil-ʾilahi tunību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v27: fayā ʿajabā man yahrubu n-nāra nāʾimā waman yaṭlubu l-jannāti wahwa laʿību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v28: kafā ʿālimā ʾanna t-turāba yaḍummuhu ṣarāʾu sharābā wal-fanā wakhashību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v29: ladhīdhu ṭaʿāmi wal-mulā wa nuʿūmatu liriksi wakharqi wal-bilā sayaʾūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v30: wayawma yafirru l-marʾu ʿan kulli ṣāḥibi kafā wāʿiẓā lil-ghāfilīna yuhību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v31: fayā ʿālimā ʿilmā walam taku ʿāmilā ʾalam yāni ʾan takhshā l-ʿalīma qulūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v32: ʾarāka tarūmu l-māla wal-jāha rifʿaha wamā hakadhā ʾahlu l-ʿulā waʾanībū
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v33: ʾarāka sirājā yaḥriqu d-dahra nafsahu munīrā lighayri ʾinna dhāka makhību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v34: ʾafī kulli yawmi taʾamuru n-nāsa nāsiyā linafsika dhā ʿāru ʿalayka yaʿību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v35: waʾin ʿamalā ʾankaḥta ʿilmā tanāsalā bimulki mudāmi laysa fīhi ḥurūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v36: waʾillā faʾinna n-nakhla laysat bināfiʿi ʾidhā lam yakun fīhā th-thimāru taṭību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v37: ʿalayka t-tuqā ʾinna l-khuyūra jamīʿahā taḍammanahā ʾinna t-taqiyyā najību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v38: raʿāyāka fāṭrud ʿan maḥārimi rabbinā biminsāti taqwā yajzi minka mujību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v39: ʾalā ʾinna khayra z-zādi taqwā ʾilahinā walā takhsha ghayra llāhi fahwa ḥasību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v40: walawlā sukūnu l-ʿālamīna lighayrihi raʾawhu ʿiyānā wal-ʾilahu qarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v41: ʾalā ʾakhliṣi l-ʾaʿmāla wāʿlam biʾannahu ghayūru falā yarḍā l-qulūba tashūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v42: walā tarḍa ʾan tulfā muṭīʿā lighayrihi wadhalika yastaḥyī ṣamīmu ʾarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v43: ʾatushrikuhu ghayrā walam yaku ḥāḍirā ladayhi ladā khalqi l-wujūdi ʿarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v44: ʾamin baʿdi khalqi dh-dhāti wal-fiʿli rabbunā yumāthilu ʿāfī l-mujrimīna ṣalību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v45: ʾalā ʾaḥsini l-ʾaʿmāla wāʿlam biʾanna mā muṭīʿu bihi lam yaʾati fahwa laʿūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v46: jalīsu malīki lam yakun mutaʾaddibā ṭarīdu dhalīlu ṣāghiru wa ḥajību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v47: ʾalā rāqibi l-mawlā l-muhaymina sayyidī faniʿma muṭīʿu lil-khabīri raqūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v48: faʾin tasʾali d-dunyā faʾinna surūrahā yaʿūdu ʿadhābā yattaqīhi ʾadību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v49: faʾin tasʾali d-dunyā faʾinna ʾumūrahā kaʾaḍghāthi ʾaḥlāmi badat wataghību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v50: faʾin tasʾali d-dunyā faʾinna ḥalālahā ḥisābu waḥabsu wal-ḥarāma ʿuqūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v51: faʾin tasʾali d-dunyā faʾinna wizānahā ʾakhaffu janāḥā lil-baʿūḍi khalūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v52: faʾin tasʾali d-dunyā faʾinna ladhīdhahā biḍurri wabuʾusi wal-balāʾi mashūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v53: fakayfa yakūnu l-farḥu wal-mawtu munẓiru wamin baʿdu ʾahwālu r-radā wakurūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v54: ʾalā fāttakhidhhā maʿbarā ʿābirā bihā walā ʿāmirā wāʿlam biʾanka gharību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v55: kafājirati tasʿā rijālā daʿathumu ʾilā baytihā wahyā r-riqāba khalūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v56: kashāribi māʾi l-baḥri man qad yarūmuhu faghghulatuhu tazdādu wahwa sharūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v57: qaṣīru yarāhā l-ghāfilūna ṭawīlata wamā hiyā ʾillā lamḥahu waghurūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v58: ʾakhī fājtahid fī l-yawmi wal-ʾamsu fāʾitu wafī ghadinā yā dhā l-wanā laghuyūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v59: qalīlu baqā minhā l-qalīlu walaw darā maghabbatahā man rāmahā layaʾūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v60: yafirru ʾilā l-mawlā kamā qāla rabbunā fafirrū ʾilā llāhi l-qarībi ʾajībū
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v61: ʾilā n-nāri maʿ kulli l-muḥibbi maṣīruhā lidhalika ʿanhā l-ʿāqilūna hurūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v62: ʾatarḍā ḥabībā yudkhilu n-nāra ḥibbahu liḥumqi wajahli ʾinna dhā latabību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v63: matā tuʿṭi ḥibbī ʾajwafayka bughāhumā ʾatā laka ʿāru musbidu wamuʿību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v64: janāḥay rajā wal-khawfi ṭir naḥwa mālikī kafāka r-radā bārī l-ʾanāmi ḥasību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v65: lisānaka ʾin ʾaṭlaqta yaʾakulka ʾinnahu kalaythi sh-sharā l-ʿādī l-jarīʾi wathūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v66: waʾimmā turid ʿawnā ʿalayka biʿuzlahi wajūʿi waṣumti ʾinnahu lanajību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v67: lahu sabʿahu l-ʾālāfi fī l-khayri qussimat ʿalā sabʿi kilmāti ʿadāka khuṭūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v68: naʿam ʾinnahu zaynu wasitru waqurbahu waḥiṣnu wabāba l-ʾiʿtidhāri yajūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v69: murīḥu l-kirāmi l-kātibīna wahaybatu faniʿma ṣamūtu khāshiʿu waʾadību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v70: ʾalā qalla man qad khālaṭa n-nāsa ṣāmitā falā budda min qīli waqāla yurību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v71: wanafsaka ʿayyib thumma baṭnaka ʿādihā wamawlāka fāshkur ʾinnahu lawahūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v72: waʾukhrāka fāṭlub thumma dunyāka fātrukan muʿiddā limā lil-ʿālamīna yudhību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v73: ʾaʿid wāndiman rudda l-maẓālima ʾahlahā ʾadhib waʾadhīqan wābki kunta tatūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v74: wanafsaka shāriṭ thumma rāqib waḥāsiban waʿāqib wajāhid ʿātibanna tanūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v75: ladā niʿmahi ṭawʿi balāʾi masīʾati ḥuqūqa ʾilahī rāʿi ḥaythu tusību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v76: kashukri waʿilmi ṭ-ṭawʿi lil-hi minnati waṣabri watawbi lil-ʾilahi ḥabību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v77: waʾiyyāka ʾiyyāka l-mirāʾa liʾannahu ʾilā sh-sharri daʿʿāʾu waminhu jalūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v78: walā taku kadhdhābā ʾamāmaka mawqifu mahību siwā l-mukhtāri fīhi raʿību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v79: wawājibuhu ʾinqādhu nafsi limuslimi wanadbu liʾirhābi l-ʿaduwwi yathūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v80: wajāʾizuhu l-ʾiṣlāḥu kurhu lizawjati siwā dhāka lil-ʿālīna ʿanhu nukūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v81: wajānib riyāʾa n-nāsi lā nafʿa minhumu walā ḍurra mā lam yaqḍi dhāka raqību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v82: ʾayanfaʿu man lā yanfaʿu l-ghayra nafsahu waman lā yaqī ḍurrā fakayfa yuṣību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v83: wal-shyāʾu ṭurrā qabḍaḍu llāhi rabbinā yuṣarrifuhā fīmā yashāʾu qarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v84: ʾalā sumʿahu mithlu r-riyāʾi waghībatu kaʾakli luḥūmi l-mayyitīna nasību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v85: waman lā yujānib ghībata n-nāsi dahrahu sayalḥaquhu yawma l-jazāʾi naḥību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v86: walā taḥsabanna llāha rabbiyā ghāfilā wamā lāfiẓu ʾillā ladayhi raqību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v87: ʾatuṣbiḥu kulla l-yawma ghayraka māniḥā khuyūraka hal yarḍā bidhāka ʾarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v88: ʾashaddu waʾadnā min thalāthīna zunyata ladā l-baʿḍi fī l-ʾislāmi sāʾa thalūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v89: qatūtu jināna llāhi lā yadkhulannahā walā qāṭiʿu l-ʾarḥāmi dhāka tabību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v90: wakadhdhib qatūtā wa nhahu wābghaḍannahu walā taḥsaban sūʾā ʾakhāka taḥūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v91: walā taku jassāsā walā tarḍa fiʿlahu lidhāka matā jāʾa l-qatūtu wajūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v92: waʾiyyāka ḍaḥkā thumma lahwā duʿābata wayaʾanafu min hadhī l-khiṣāli ḥasību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v93: walā tanzilu r-ruḥmā bimajlisi ghībati wadhikri d-dunā ḍaḥki naḥāka nukūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v94: wafiʿlaka lā taʿjab wa lā tatakabbaran faʾinnaka fī shakki hudīta yurību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v95: walā taʿtaqid faḍlā ʿalā l-ghayri taghtarir faʾinna khitāma l-ʾamri ʿanka yaghību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v96: waḥaqqu ʿalā t-tujjāri ʾan lā yufākhirū qubayla rabāḥi wal-ḥisābu ḥazību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v97: falā taʾamanan makra l-ʾilahi ʾamānata waman yaʾamanan makra l-ʾilahi yakhību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v98: waʾiyyāka sūʾa ẓ-ẓanni yawmā ʾilā l-warā walā siyyamā r-raḥmanu fāza munību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v99: ʾalā ʾinna baʿḍa ẓ-ẓani ʾithmu muʿayyibu ʾalā ʾinnahu lil-kādhibīna rakūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v100: walā tarḍa ghayra llāhi yawmā wakālata ʾalā ʾinnahu kāfī l-ʾanāmi ḥasību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v101: waʾiyyāka ʾiyyāka l-ghiḍāba liqawlihi "khudhi l-ʿafwa wāmur" ʾinna dhā laʿajību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v102: waʾiyyāka qaṭʿa n-naẓri ʿan naḥwi rabbinā ʾilā man yusī kay lā yajīʾa ʿuqūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v103: ʾafī dārihi wal-mulki wal-milki fāʿilu ʿalā khalqihi mā lā yashāʾu muṣību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v104: ʾidhā mā btulīta ṣbir ʾawi ʿṭīta fāshkuran waʿāfi ẓalūmā ʾin ẓulimta tatūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v105: wataʿẓīmu ʾamri llāhi ḥamlu ʾadhā l-warā humā mawridu ṣāfī z-zulāli raghību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v106: falā taku lawwāma l-khalīqati ʾinnahu fuḍūlu ʾalā ʾinna l-fuḍūla maʿību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v107: ʾalam tara ʾanna l-khalqa tajrī ʾumūruhum ʿalā mā yashāʾu llāhu wahwa raqību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v108: ʾalā ʾinnahu yubdī sh-shuʾūna likhalqihi ladā kulli yawmi lil-ʿuṣāti yatūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v109: ʾidhā mā ramāka d-dahru yawmā baliyyata yukaffaru min dhāka l-balāʾi dhunūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v110: waʾin zidta minhā ṣ-ṣabra ʾayqin biʾannahu bighayri ḥisābi liṣ-ṣabūri yuthību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v111: wayumḥā bihā mā laysa tamḥāhu ṭāʿatu wataʾamulu law dāmat ʿalayka kurūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v112: walā tanzaʿij ʾin ḍāqa ʾamru faʾinnamā tafarrujuhu ʾimmā ṣabarta qarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v113: ʾalā qallili l-himmāti ʾin qāla kun yakun wamā lam yakun yaʾatīhi laysa yaṣūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v114: ʾamin baʿdi waʿdi llāhi thumma ḍamānihi waʾaqsāmihi yaʾatī l-fuʾāda wajību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v115: wadāwim ʿalā dhikri lladhī jalla dhikruhu bidhikri ʾilahī taṭmaʾinnu qulūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v116: liyulfika mā ʾuḥyīta mawlāka dhākirā ʾukhayyā ṭulūʿa sh-shamsi thumma ghurūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v117: walakinna jadwā dh-dhikri ʾin lam yakun bihi ḥuḍūru qalīlu wal-ḥuḍūru gharību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v118: waʾin turidan nayla l-wuṣūli likhāliqī ʿalayka ʿalā l-hādī ṣ-ṣalātu tuṣību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v119: wamā khalaqa r-raḥmanu shayʾā linafsihi siwā s-sayyidi l-maḥmūdi wahwa ḥabību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v120: waʾawjada bāqī l-khalqi taʿẓīma ḥibbihi ʿalayhi taḥḥiyātu l-ʾilahi taṭību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v121: wadhā n-naẓmu yakfī s-sālikīna liʾannahu baṣīru biʾadwāʾi l-qulūbi ṭabību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v122: waṣallā ʿalā l-mukhtāri ḥīnā musallimā ʾilahu duʿāʾa l-muljiʾīna yujību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v123: maʿa l-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi ṭurrā dhawī l-ʿulā waman yaqtafī ʾāthārahum wayunību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v124: waḍaʿ rabbi wizrā kāna ʾanqaḍa ẓahranā bijāhi nabiyyi yartajīhi kaʾību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v125: fayā rabbi ʾin lam yaku yarjūka mudhnibu famā ban-nā yawma l-khabīru ḥasību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v126: falaysa lanā rabbu siwāka wamālanā malādhu walā manjā siwāka yatūbu
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v127: ʿalā wad-di fāghfir washaykhi wamuḥsini kadhāka jamīʿi l-muslimīna qarību
verses.elhadji-malick-sy-zajrul-qulub-c1-v128: ʿalā khayri khalqi llāhi ʾazkā taḥḥiyati madā d-dahri yā raḥmanu rabbi mujību
